personalInfo.name: Mohamed Hasain N
personalInfo.institution: Transportation Systems Engineering Lab, Department of Civil Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Bombay

professionalBackground: Dr. Mohamed Hasain N holds a doctorate in Transportation Engineering from the National Institute of Technology Silchar, India. His research interests include traffic safety analysis, crash modelling, transportation planning, and direct demand modelling using machine learning techniques. He was awarded the University Silver Medal for academic excellence in his master's program at NIT Silchar. Dr. Hasain is currently serving as a Post-Doctoral Researcher at the Transportation Systems Engineering Laboratory, Department of Civil Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Bombay. He has been actively involved in several research projects aimed at improving safe and secure first- and last-mile connectivity, particularly for pedestrians, in metro transit systems, as well as assessing the resilience of suburban rail networks in emerging countries in response to rainfall events.

phdChecklist.title: PhD / MTech Application Checklist for IIT Programs

categories.name: Application Timeline
items: Check JOAPS / institute portal for deadlines (usually March–May)
Prepare GATE scorecard well in advance
Draft SOP at least 2 weeks before deadline
Submit application before the last date
Prepare for written test / interview (May–June typically)

categories.name: SOP Tips
items: Start with your motivation and research interest
Explain why this specific lab / professor / department
Keep it concise, specific, and genuine
Proofread multiple times – no grammar errors

categories.name: Common Mistakes to Avoid
items: Generic SOP not tailored to the program
Not mentioning GATE score or rank clearly
Not researching the professor's work before interview
Submitting blurry scans or incorrect file formats
